_about: Work Journal category 1: each runtime's built-in tools that map to a journal action. Keys are runtime kinds; tool names are as recorded in raw traces (after AutoByteus's adapters). Every name NOT listed for the run's runtime (other built-ins, MCP tools, AutoByteus shared tools) uses the generic Tool rule (work-journal-contract.md section 5). Source of truth: work-journal-contract.md section 4.

antigravity_cli.call_mcp_tool: unwrap {ServerName, ToolName, Arguments}, then apply the generic rule (older records; newer records are already unwrapped by the AGY adapter)
